During an off-campus summit in Los Angeles, CSU professor Melina Abdullah publicly shared the suspected hotel location of ICE agent Brian Palacios, urging the crowd to target him following a controversial off-duty shooting.

The Bright Side:
The immediate public backlash forced Abdullah to attempt to walk back her comments, highlighting that the broader community still rejects direct incitement to physical violence as a legitimate form of protest.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The error lies in confusing the WHO (protecting vulnerable communities) with the HOW (inciting a mob to attack an individual). By substituting systemic advocacy with targeted physical intimidation, the movement's moral authority is entirely compromised.

Social Physics Analysis:
Abdullah executes a Smart Selfish Maneuver, using the pretext of civil rights to justify personal radical branding. By projecting systemic "terror" onto a single off-duty agent, she manufactures a crisis to hoard activist power while risking real-world harm.

The Trajectory: The Path of Fall into Destruction.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Destruction. The collapse of u to -0.88 reflects the active abandonment of systemic justice for raw chaos.

The Unavoidable Truth: Doxxing an individual and telling a crowd to "fuck him up" is an explicit incitement to violence.
The Unavoidable Lie: Claiming that "fuck him up" was merely a metaphor for prayer and legal defense is a credible or honest defense.

Alethekanon:
Incitement is the ultimate failure of systemic logic. When an academic trades structural critique for mob intimidation, they do not dismantle oppression; they merely replicate its rawest, most lawless mechanisms.

Awwthekanon:
True justice is built on healing and protecting the vulnerable, not on directing anger and danger toward another human being. When we let rage guide our words, we lose the empathy that is supposed to heal our communities.

Brothekanon:
Look, if you're telling a crowd exactly where a guy is staying and yelling "fuck him up," you can't act surprised when people call it doxxing and threat. Trying to say you meant "powerful prayer" after that is just wild.

Spirithekanon:
"Hatred is never appeased by hatred in this world. By non-hatred alone is hatred appeased. This is a law eternal." Dhammapada 1:5 FAIL
Inciting a mob to target an individual only perpetuates the cycle of violence, destroying the moral foundation of true liberation.
